description: Recompute topology, sequon, conservation and model-based accessibility values from source and write the consolidated evidence matrix and GO decision table
code:
import requests, re, os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
OUT="/agent/jobs/6811dc4d-ddff-4159-9963-5139baa317dd/provenance"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- recompute core numbers from source
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9VFA8.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
L=len(seq); print("Q9VFA8 length",L,"| residue 106 =",seq[105])

KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2,'X':0.0}
w=19; h=np.array([np.mean([KD[c] for c in seq[i:i+w]]) for i in range(L-w+1)])
hx=np.arange(1,L-w+2)+w//2
peak=int(hx[np.argmax(h)]); print(f"KD max {h.max():.2f} at residue {peak}; windows >1.6: {(h>1.6).sum()}")

def q(s): return sum(c in "KR" for c in s)-sum(c in "DE" for c in s)
nf,cf=seq[87:102],seq[125:140]
print(f"N-flank 88-102 {nf} net {q(nf):+d} | C-flank 126-140 {cf} net {q(cf):+d} | delta {q(cf)-q(nf):+d}")

seq_sites=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r"(?=N[^P][ST])",seq)]
print("N-X-S/T sequons:",seq_sites,"| in ectodomain 19-102:",[p for p in seq_sites if 19<=p<=102])
print("PPxY motifs:",[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r"PP.Y",seq)])

cons=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/cg42404_ppxy_conservation.csv")
geo=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/cg42404_PPPY_backbone_geometry.csv")
env=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/ppxy_local_environment_alphafold.csv")
print("\nconservation cols:",list(cons.columns)); print(cons.head(3).to_string(index=False))
print("\nenvironment table:"); print(env.to_string(index=False))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- consolidated evidence matrix
EM=[
("PMID:14605208","interaction (Y2H, high-throughput)","supports (weakly)","CG42404 binds a WW-domain protein",
 "Kibra (Q9VFG8) is the only WW-domain protein among 15 IntAct partners of Q9VFA8","D. melanogaster, yeast two-hybrid",
 "Low-moderate: single high-throughput Y2H, no domain mapping, PMID 15710747 reports little overlap between fly Y2H datasets"),
("PMID:16531238","structural (NMR)","supports","A PY motif with a di-acidic +1/+2 flank and a following helix is a dNedd4 WW ligand",
 "Comm PY2 TGLPSY-DE-ALH bound to dNedd4 WW3*; helical turn follows the PPII PY core; CG42404 EAPPPY-EE-AVAISQAEAL has the same architecture",
 "D. melanogaster proteins, in vitro NMR","Moderate: direct structure, but of a different ligand; CG42404 binding is inferred from motif architecture only"),
("UniProt P98153 / Q9VFA8 (database)","review/database","qualifies","CG42404 is a DGCR2/IDD family type I membrane protein",
 "Same curated architecture (signal peptide, VWFC, single TM) but inverted proportions: human 329-aa ectodomain with LDL-A and C-type lectin plus 182-aa tail, versus fly 84-aa ectodomain plus 1008-aa tail",
 "H. sapiens vs D. melanogaster","Moderate: family assignment from PANTHER PTHR15256 and InterPro, not structural superposition"),
("This work (computational)","computational","supports","Single TM segment",
 f"Only one Kyte-Doolittle window above 1.6 in {L} residues, max {h.max():.2f} at residue {peak}, inside the curated TM 103-125",
 "Q9VFA8 sequence","High for TM presence; boundaries are from UniProt, not re-derived"),
("This work (computational)","computational","supports","Type I orientation, cytoplasmic C-terminus",
 f"Positive-inside rule: 15-residue flanks give {q(nf):+d} (N-side) and {q(cf):+d} (C-side), delta {q(cf)-q(nf):+d}, with 7 K/R in the C-flank and 0 in the N-flank",
 "Q9VFA8 sequence","High: charge bias is large and unambiguous"),
("This work (computational)","computational","supports","PPPY at 193-196 is cytoplasm-facing",
 "Motif lies 68 residues C-terminal to the TM helix, on the side assigned cytoplasmic by the positive-inside test",
 "Q9VFA8 sequence","High, conditional on the topology call"),
("This work (computational)","computational","refutes","Ectodomain N-glycosylation sites can be predicted",
 f"All {len(seq_sites)} N-X-S/T sequons ({', '.join(map(str,seq_sites))}) are cytoplasmic; zero in the 84-residue ectodomain 19-102",
 "Q9VFA8 sequence","High: sequon scanning is deterministic; does not exclude O-glycosylation"),
("This work (computational)","structural/evolutionary","supports","Motif and flanks are conserved",
 "PPPY core identity 1.000 in 22 Drosophila and 214 Insecta PTHR15256 proteins from 108 genera; flanks 188P 0.930, 189R 0.972, 190G 0.986, 191E 0.963, 192A 0.995, 197E 0.771, 198E 1.000, 199A 0.967; mean window identity 0.955 (Drosophila), 0.678 (Insecta)",
 "Insecta, UniProt PTHR15256 members","High for conservation; purifying selection on a 4-residue motif is strong evidence of function but not of partner identity"),
("MobiDB (database)","computational","qualifies","The PPPY lies in a disordered segment",
 "MobiDB-lite consensus coverage 0.351, 9 long IDRs, earliest starting at 265; none contains 193-196. th_50 flags only 190-191 and 195. TOP-IDP at 195 is +0.327, the 96.4th percentile of this protein's own windows",
 "Q9VFA8","Moderate: predictors disagree; the motif is non-globular and proline-rich but outside consensus long IDRs"),
("AlphaFold DB (resource limit)","computational","qualifies","AlphaFold modelling of CG42404",
 "AFDB returns HTTP 404 for Q9VFA8; no model exists, almost certainly because residue 106 is X in the reference sequence. The requested modelling and structure-based relative search could not be run on this entry",
 "Q9VFA8","Stated limitation, not a result"),
("AlphaFold DB B4QZ29/B3P0S9/B4HDZ6/B4GLA8","computational","supports","The motif is accessible",
 "Ortholog tails are near-fully disordered (B4QZ29 mean pLDDT 37.6, 89.2% below 50). Exactly two ordered islands: a polyQ/polyA repeat (known artefact) and APPPYEEAVAISQAEAL. PPPY pLDDT 61.4-75.2 (96.0-99.8th percentile per protein); CA neighbours 1.5-2.8 versus 13.1 for the folded human C-type lectin core",
 "Four Drosophila orthologs, proxy for Q9VFA8","Moderate-high for accessibility; ortholog models are a declared proxy and their numbering differs"),
("This work (computational)","computational","competing","Partner class is Yorkie",
 "Of 18 PY motifs in CG42404, Comm, Expanded, Warts, Hippo, Tgi and NcoA6, only CG42404 (E197/E198) and Comm PY2 (D233/E234) carry a di-acidic +1/+2 pair; every Yorkie-binding Hippo-pathway motif lacks it",
 "D. melanogaster UniProt sequences","Moderate: a single flank feature across a small motif set; argues against Yorkie as the best match without excluding it"),
("IntAct / PSICQUIC","review/database","qualifies","Direct interaction evidence for Q9VFA8",
 "15 interaction records; no Nedd4, Su(dx), Smurf, Hecw or Yorkie among them; 79 Dmel proteins carry a PROSITE PS50020 WW domain, so the search space is large and largely untested",
 "D. melanogaster","Moderate: absence in IntAct reflects untested pairs as much as non-binding"),
("UniProt Q9VYJ3 (database)","structural/evolutionary","qualifies","Paralog confusion",
 "The Dmel DGCR2-related protein CG32647 (Q9VYJ3, 233 aa) has no PPxY motif, so motif-based inferences must not be transferred between the two",
 "D. melanogaster","High: direct sequence check"),
("RefSeq NP_650437.4 / NP_001247118.1","review/database","qualifies","Isoform dependence",
 "Both annotated transcripts encode the same 1133-residue protein with PPPY at 193, so the motif is not isoform specific",
 "D. melanogaster","High"),
]
em=pd.DataFrame(EM,columns=["citation","evidence_type","direction","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_and_limitations"])
em.to_csv(f"{OUT}/cg42404_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("\nevidence matrix rows:",len(em),"|",em.direction.value_counts().to_dict())

GO=[
("GO:0016021 / GO:0005886","CC","integral component of membrane / plasma membrane","lead: add with ISS/ISM, qualify compartment",
 "Single TM plus signal peptide plus positive-inside delta +11 support an integral type I membrane protein. The specific membrane is not determined by sequence; plasma membrane is the family default and needs verification"),
("GO:0098552","CC","side of membrane (cytoplasmic side) for the tail","lead: supporting detail, not a standalone annotation",
 "Topology places residues 126-1133, including the PPPY, in the cytoplasm"),
("GO:0005515","MF","protein binding","lead: avoid as the final term",
 "Supported by PMID 14605208 but uninformative; use a more specific child if a partner class is confirmed"),
("GO:0050699","MF","WW domain binding","lead: strongest candidate MF, needs experimental verification",
 "An invariant cytoplasmic PPPY with a di-acidic flank, fully exposed in ortholog models, plus one Y2H record with the WW protein Kibra. No direct binding assay exists, so this is a lead, not an annotation-ready call"),
("GO:0050839 or a Nedd4-related child","MF","cell adhesion molecule binding / E3 ligase binding","lead: competing options to discriminate",
 "Family membership (DGCR2/IDD, VWFC) points to adhesion; motif architecture matching PMID 16531238 points to a Nedd4-family WW domain"),
("GO:0035329","BP","hippo signaling","lead: do not add",
 "The only WW link is Kibra by Y2H. The CG42404 flank does not match the Yorkie-binding PY motifs of Expanded, Warts, Hippo, Tgi or NcoA6"),
("GO:0016567","BP","protein ubiquitination","lead: do not add",
 "A PY motif makes a protein a candidate Nedd4 substrate, which is a prediction about the protein's regulation, not a demonstrated activity"),
("GO:0006486","BP","protein glycosylation","lead: do not add; actively argues against N-glycosylation annotation",
 "Zero N-X-S/T sequons in the 84-residue ectodomain; all 8 sequons are cytoplasmic"),
]
go=pd.DataFrame(GO,columns=["term","aspect","label","recommended_action","basis"])
go.to_csv(f"{OUT}/cg42404_GO_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("GO decision rows:",len(go))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- figure built only from values computed above
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,9)); gs=GridSpec(3,2,figure=fig,hspace=0.55,wspace=0.26)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.plot(hx,h,lw=0.8,color="#333"); ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",lw=0.8,color="#999")
ax.axvspan(103,125,color="#F58518",alpha=0.35); ax.axvspan(1,18,color="#72B7B2",alpha=0.35)
ax.axvspan(27,92,color="#54A24B",alpha=0.20); ax.axvline(193,color="#E45756",lw=1.2)
ax.annotate("TM 103-125",(114,h.max()),ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.annotate("PPPY 193",(193,2.0),color="#E45756",fontsize=8,ha="left")
ax.set_xlim(0,L); ax.set_xlabel("residue (Q9VFA8, 1133 aa)"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle\n(window 19)")
ax.set_title(f"One hydrophobic segment in the whole protein: max {h.max():.2f} at residue {peak}",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.bar(["N-side\n88-102","C-side\n126-140"],[q(nf),q(cf)],color=["#4C78A8","#E45756"])
ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8); ax.set_ylabel("net charge (K+R) - (D+E)")
ax.set_title(f"Positive-inside rule: delta {q(cf)-q(nf):+d}\ntype I, C-terminus cytoplasmic",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
pos=cons["position"] if "position" in cons.columns else cons.iloc[:,0]
dro=[c for c in cons.columns if "dros" in c.lower()][0]; ins=[c for c in cons.columns if "insect" in c.lower() or "insecta" in c.lower()][0]
ax.plot(pos,cons[dro],"o-",ms=4,label="Drosophila (n=22)",color="#4C78A8")
ax.plot(pos,cons[ins],"s-",ms=4,label="Insecta (n=214)",color="#F58518")
ax.axvspan(193,196,color="#E45756",alpha=0.25)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.05); ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("fractional identity")
ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.set_title("PPPY core identity 1.000 in both sets",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
g=geo.copy(); xc=[c for c in g.columns if "pos" in c.lower() or "res" in c.lower()][0]
pl=[c for c in g.columns if "plddt" in c.lower()][0]; dd=[c for c in g.columns if "ca" in c.lower() or "d4" in c.lower()]
ax.plot(g[xc],g[pl],"-o",ms=3,color="#54A24B"); ax.axhline(50,ls=":",color="#999",lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("residue (B4QZ29, D. simulans model)"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("Motif sits in the only non-artefact\nordered island of the tail",fontsize=10)
if dd:
    ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.plot(g[xc],g[dd[0]],"-s",ms=3,color="#B279A2",alpha=0.8)
    ax2.set_ylabel("CA(i)-CA(i+4), A",color="#B279A2"); ax2.axhline(6.2,ls="--",lw=0.7,color="#B279A2")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1])
lab=env.iloc[:,0].astype(str).str[:22]; nb=[c for c in env.columns if "nbr" in c.lower() or "neigh" in c.lower()][0]
ax.barh(lab,env[nb],color="#4C78A8"); ax.axvline(13.1,color="#E45756",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.text(13.3,0.2,"folded C-type\nlectin core = 13.1",color="#E45756",fontsize=7,va="bottom")
ax.set_xlabel("CA neighbours within 10 A (|i-j| > 4)"); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.tick_params(axis="y",labelsize=7); ax.set_title("PPxY motifs have almost no packing partners",fontsize=10)

fig.suptitle("CG42404 (Q9VFA8): type I membrane topology and an invariant, exposed cytoplasmic PPPY",fontsize=12)
plt.show()
